SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, s.spec AS specification, s.clause AS clause FROM document d JOIN disposition v ON v.target=d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id=v.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id=r.meeting_id AND m.wg='RAN5' AND v.evidence_status='source_verified' AND v.scope='whole_target' JOIN cr_in_pack cp ON cp.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=cp.pack_id JOIN cr_modifies_section cs ON cs.cr=d.id JOIN section s ON s.id=cs.section_id WHERE p.pack_number='RP-230947' AND s.release=d.target_release AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cr_modifies_section es JOIN document ed ON ed.id=es.cr JOIN cr_in_pack epc ON epc.cr=ed.id JOIN cr_pack ep ON ep.id=epc.pack_id WHERE es.section_id=s.id AND ed.target_release=s.release AND ep.tsg_number<p.tsg_number)

SELECT DISTINCT s.spec AS specification, s.clause AS clause, prior.pack_number AS cr_pack, prior.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting FROM cr_pack prior, document d JOIN disposition v ON v.target=d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id=v.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id=r.meeting_id AND m.wg='RAN5' AND v.evidence_status='source_verified' AND v.scope='whole_target' JOIN cr_in_pack cp ON cp.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=cp.pack_id JOIN cr_modifies_section cs ON cs.cr=d.id JOIN section s ON s.id=cs.section_id WHERE p.pack_number='RP-261275' AND s.release=d.target_release AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cr_modifies_section es JOIN document ed ON ed.id=es.cr JOIN cr_in_pack epc ON epc.cr=ed.id WHERE es.section_id=s.id AND ed.target_release=s.release AND epc.pack_id=prior.id) AND prior.tsg_number=(SELECT MAX(ep.tsg_number) FROM cr_modifies_section es JOIN document ed ON ed.id=es.cr JOIN cr_in_pack epc ON epc.cr=ed.id JOIN cr_pack ep ON ep.id=epc.pack_id WHERE es.section_id=s.id AND ed.target_release=s.release AND ep.tsg_number<p.tsg_number)
